results.title: Mainland: Taiwan question is foundation of China-US relations
results.description: The Taiwan question is at the core of China's core interests and is the most important issue in China-US relations, Zhang Han, a spokesperson for the Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council said on Wednesday.

results.title: Amid SIR, Hyderabad graduates’ constituency voter registration begins
results.description: Hyderabad: Telangana Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) C Sudharshan Reddy has invited applications for the Hyderabad graduates’ constituency amid the ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in the state. Apart from the Mahabubnagar-Rangareddy-Hyderabad constituency, applications are invited for the Warangal–Khammam–Nalgonda constituency.
